result.summary: Rebuilt the customer profile as CustomerProfile/PrimaryGuardianPanel/CustomerAgenda, replacing the phone-driven detail view with an id-driven one and a full propose/confirm/remove guardian flow.
result.report:
Extracted the old inline `CustomerDetail` function from `ProductCustomersScreen.tsx` (a leftover from the pre-WU-01/03 monolith) into three dedicated files, as required by expectedFiles:

- `CustomerProfile.tsx`: loads `CustomerDetail` by `customerId` via `BffCustomerService.get`, plus `CalendarState` for the external/Atendly source strip. Renders explicit "não informado" text for absent name/phone in view mode; an "Editar dados" affordance (gated by `calendar.capabilities.manageCustomers`, matching the existing external-readonly convention) switches to a `Field`-based form that calls `BffCustomerService.update` and merges the result back into state. Load failures render a `StatePanel` with a retry action while keeping the header/back-link structure intact (no full-page swallow). Passes `customer.id` (never `phone`) and the calendar timezone down to `CustomerAgenda`.
- `PrimaryGuardianPanel.tsx`: shows guardian name/phone plus a `directory-timeline` with proveniência (who proposed and when; who confirmed and when, when applicable) and a PROPOSED/CONFIRMED badge. "Propor responsável" (or "Trocar responsável" when one exists) opens a searchable picker built on `BffCustomerService.list()` filtered client-side (excluding the current customer) and calls `setPrimaryGuardian`; "Confirmar" calls `confirmPrimaryGuardian`; "Remover" calls `clearPrimaryGuardian` and correctly normalizes the `{deleted:true} | guardian | null` response back to `null`. All actions are gated by the same `editable` flag as the profile.
- `CustomerAgenda.tsx`: fetches `BffCalendarService.listAppointments({ customerId, ... })` — no `customerPhone` anywhere — for a ±365-day window, then splits the result client-side into "Próximos atendimentos" (active status, date ≥ today) and "Histórico" (everything else), each with its own empty state, and a shared error state with a retry that only clears local error/reload state (no direct setState-in-effect, to satisfy the `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` lint rule already enforced in this repo).

Rewired `ProductCustomersScreen.tsx` into a thin 3-branch router (`CustomerProfile` / `CustomerForm` / `CustomerList`) since the old inline detail implementation and its private helpers became dead code once extracted — this wiring was necessary for the new by-id behavior to actually take effect for the `/clientes/detalhes` and `/clientes/detalhes/externo` routes, both of which already pass `customerId`/`scenario="detail"` unchanged. Added one small `.guardian-picker` rule to `atendly-customers.css` (existing `directory-*` classes from `atendly-directory.css` covered everything else, including the timeline used for guardian proveniência).

No notes/tags/memory/summary UI was added — those are out of this unit's scope per expectedFiles and are presumably WU-05's privacy-guardrail unit.

Commands executed from `apps/frontend`:
- `npm run typecheck` → passes, no errors.
- `npm run lint` (max-warnings=0) → initially caught 2 `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` errors (redundant `setState(null)` calls at the top of the fetch effects in `CustomerAgenda`/`CustomerProfile`); removed them (matching the existing `CustomerList.tsx` pattern of only clearing error state from the retry handler) and reran → passes clean.
- `npm test` (vitest) → 14 files / 101 tests passed, no regressions.
- `npm run build` (next build) → compiles successfully; `/clientes/detalhes` and `/clientes/detalhes/externo` both list as dynamic routes as before.

`git status` confirms only the expected files plus `ProductCustomersScreen.tsx` and `atendly-customers.css` were touched by this unit; all other pending changes in the tree belong to other work units (WU-02/WU-03/WU-06) and were left untouched.

acceptance.criterion: Toda requisição de agenda ou histórico feita pelo perfil usa customerId; nenhuma usa customerPhone
acceptance.detail: CustomerAgenda.tsx calls BffCalendarService.listAppointments({ customerId, ... }); customerPhone is never referenced in the new files (verified by reading the final file and by typecheck passing against ListAppointmentsQuery).

acceptance.criterion: Cliente sem telefone exibe próximos atendimentos e histórico normalmente
acceptance.detail: The fetch in CustomerAgenda no longer branches on customer.phone (the old `if (!nextCustomer.phone) return;` guard was removed); it always fetches by customer.id regardless of phone presence.

acceptance.criterion: Responsável principal mostra quem propôs, quando e o estado PROPOSED ou CONFIRMED, e permite propor, confirmar e remover
acceptance.detail: PrimaryGuardianPanel.tsx renders proposedBy/proposedByActor/proposedAt (and confirmedBy/confirmedByActor/confirmedAt when CONFIRMED) in a directory-timeline plus a PROPOSED/CONFIRMED badge, and offers Propor/Trocar, Confirmar and Remover actions wired to setPrimaryGuardian/confirmPrimaryGuardian/clearPrimaryGuardian.

acceptance.criterion: Nome e telefone são editáveis e a ausência de cada um é apresentada explicitamente, não como campo vazio
acceptance.detail: CustomerProfile view mode renders 'Cliente sem nome' / 'Telefone não informado' text instead of blank fields; edit mode uses Field inputs saved via BffCustomerService.update.

acceptance.criterion: Erro de carregamento do perfil é recuperável e preserva a estrutura da tela
acceptance.detail: CustomerProfile keeps the page header/back-link outside the conditional and renders a StatePanel with a 'Tentar novamente' action (bumping a reload counter) instead of collapsing the whole page on failure.
